resources.string: Swipe the calendar down to see more of the month, up to see more of the day.
That\'s it. Swipe either way whenever you want more or less.
Press and hold where nothing is scheduled to start an event on that day.
The editor opened on the day you held. Nothing is saved unless you save it.
Swipe up from the pill to open your views and search.
That\u2019s the quick way to move between views.
Press and hold the pill to switch it between the compact pill and the dock.
Hold it again to switch back. It returns to how you had it when you finish.
Slide a time sideways to move it by quarter hours. Right is later, left is earlier.
Nice. Slide the line between the times to move the whole event.
Write a dated note any day. Open Journal from the pill\u2019s view menu or the sidebar.
Your address book lives in Calino as well. Open Contacts from the pill\u2019s view menu or the sidebar.
The short walk through Calino\u2019s gestures, again
